_VESSEL_MATCHING_RULE: A warning is credited to a waterway only when a position stated in its text (read in full, before the 500-character cut) lies within proximity_km of the waterway's reference point. A warning that states no readable position is credited to no waterway: its area code names at least a whole NAVAREA (area_codes), far wider than proximity_km. Naval ones are listed in unplaced_naval_warnings with the reason. status counts the naval-keyword warnings credited to the waterway; it reads stale when the feed's newest warning is older than stale_after_days and unknown when the feed is unavailable or how current it is cannot be checked (feed_stale null: no usable issue date, or no active warnings at all). total_nearby counts credited warnings of any topic.
